value.rationale: This is a complete phase classification for a smallest genuinely noncommuting two-component strongly convex SGD example. It separates per-initial-state reliability from worst-direction guarantees under two natural equal-cost sampling schemes, with an exact ratio bound and small rational witness. The nontrivial question is whether a global norm advantage implies a per-vector risk advantage; the theorem resolves precisely when it does in this family. It neither presumes novelty from numerical checks nor claims multi-epoch improvement.
